Tamil women wearing traditional handwoven sarees with period-appropriate draping
village elders, children, agricultural workers and temple devotees
young men participating in a traditional jallikattu event
animals: strong native Tamil cattle breeds such as Kangayam-type bulls
humped bulls decorated with traditional cloth and flower garlands
working oxen pulling wooden ploughs and bullock carts
cows and calves around village homes
cultural_details: traditional jasmine flowers in women's braided hair
traditional agricultural tools made from wood and iron
authentic rural Tamil appearance and hairstyles

Composition.framing: wide panoramic composition showing village life, agricultural fields and a jallikattu arena within one coherent landscape
Composition.foreground: a powerful decorated native bull and several farmers preparing for jallikattu, with spectators standing at a safe traditional viewing area
Composition.middle_ground: farmers ploughing fertile paddy fields with pairs of oxen, bullock carts carrying agricultural produce, villagers tending cattle
Composition.background: traditional Tamil village houses, coconut and palmyra palms, a historic temple tower, irrigation tank and distant green agricultural fields
Composition.depth: strong foreground, middle-ground and background separation with realistic atmospheric perspective
Composition.camera: 35mm cinematic photography, eye-level perspective with a slightly elevated panoramic viewpoint
Composition.visual_focus: the decorated bull as the focal point, while farming and village life remain clearly visible

Action.historical_note: depict jallikattu as a traditional Tamil bull-taming festival without modern stadium infrastructure, modern safety equipment or contemporary event branding

architecture: traditional Tamil village houses with lime-plastered or earthen walls
Location.jallikattu_setting: a simple open village ground surrounded by spectators, temporary wooden or natural-fiber barriers and traditional village structures
Location.season: agricultural festival season, with vibrant green fields and warm tropical sunlight

Esthatic.materials: handwoven cotton, rough wood, aged stone, terracotta, leather, natural fiber, mud and weathered metal
